summary: ITRI showcased solutions at TAITRONICS Autumn and TaiwanRFID, hosted The 4th Jinyi Award Ceremony, and accompanied PV Taiwan Forum and Exhibition. ITRI and Taiwan Design Center supervised by TAITRA judged the three-group competition and named winners. After the ceremony ITRI held a photovoltaic construction seminar where Dr. Joeng-shein Chen urged learning from Europe and USA and noted South Taiwan projects.
